subject: Explainable routing status: both regions reproducing, eval design question
body:
Hi Anders, Daniela,

Status. Milan hit the May 1 build milestone: the CMake/Abseil build is containerized, Release-mode only (the compiler-optimization difference on graph loading is dramatic - about 6x on Washington), and both released regions - baden-processed and washington-processed - reproduce the reference explanation outputs. Gustavo's subgraph caching brings repeated scenario runs from ~40 min to under 4.

Rafael's eval framework is mid-flight for May 29. One design question we want a PM read on: explanation quality has two axes - faithfulness (does the explanation reflect the actual cost differences that flipped the route?) and comprehensibility (would a user accept it?). Faithfulness we can score automatically against scenario ground truth; comprehensibility needs human raters. A 300-explanation rater study adds roughly two weeks and modest cost.

My recommendation: do it. A partner demo claiming "explanations" with no human-acceptance number invites the obvious question.

Wei
